newsitem.title: UK: Copenhagen Re announces results, capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Copenhagen Re announces results, capital increase.

text.p: Danish reinsurer Copenhagen Re on Thursday announced 1996 results and a cash boost from its parent Alm. Brand.

Shareholder funds have been boosted to 1.509 billion crowns and total equity including equalisation reserves to 1.812 billion, an increase of 604 million, the company said in a statement issued in London.
The company said the capital increase would strengthen its position in the international market.

Managing director Leif Corinth-Hansen said the capital increase was a vote of confidence in the company's policy of "conservative, sustainable growth which will continue well into the next millennium."
Pre-tax profits for 1996 were 351 million crowns before allocations to equalisation funds and second only to the record 1995 profit figure of 418 million.
Copenhagen Re said its main growth areas were in Asia and Latin America.
Copenhagen Re (UK) made a pre-tax profit of 8.6 million stg on gross premium income of 67 million stg.
